d.ko: This is a surreal exploration game.  Explore a massive fractal with great complexities.  You can shrink infinitely to go deeper into the fractal.  Or you can become larger by growing.  Inner space awaits you in this infinite world.

rv.t: When I was a kid I used to look at the edges of pavement and the blades of grass next to them and imagine they were superstructures or skyscrapers with things living in the little cracks and faults and I was flying high above it all
When you are 238 levels deep into the ying forest you start to understand. Great game
神作。原始狂野的探索欲驱使你前进，我仿佛回到了那个人类的年轻时代，那时万事万物都还没有名字，每一次触碰都是惊惶与渴望。有可能游戏制作人触摸到了电子游戏的终极形态，也有可能我只是溜大了。
真帅吧这游戏 太广阔了，很符合我对宇宙的想象 就是需要截图的地方有点多
